sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Deminerim is a lightning-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Agility (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Deminerim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Luck (C). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
